title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-20
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Reel to Reel > PCM > CDR

ai_review.summary: A goose‑bumps‑inducing show praised by fans, captured on an unspecified source that caused no complaints about sound quality.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the energy and emotional impact of this performance, calling it a “goosebump” experience and noting that "Eyes" (likely Eyes of the World) was especially strong. One comment mentions an unexpected horn/elephant‑like intrusion around the 8:35 mark, but it didn’t dampen enthusiasm – all three reviewers awarded five stars.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 5‑star and uniformly enthusiastic about the show; no recording issues were reported, suggesting both a great performance and an acceptable recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention any audio flaws or mixing problems, implying the recording is at least listenable and free of major issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans describe a high‑energy set that delivers several goosebump moments; one reviewer notes an odd horn/elephant intrusion around 8:35, but overall the flow is praised.
